h1: Order reports you can read in five minutes
overview: We turn your order data into reports that answer practical questions. How many orders came in, which products sell, how many were returned and why, how long delivery takes and where orders get stuck. We build the reports in your store, a spreadsheet or a dashboard you own, set them to refresh weekly or monthly and explain each figure in plain words. You also get notes on what stands out and what to look at next.

faq: In a spreadsheet or dashboard owned by you, such as Google Sheets or Looker Studio, or in your store's own reports. We do not keep your data on our systems.
Do you need access to customer details?
Reports use order data, and we try to avoid personal data wherever it is not needed. We work as staff in your store, and follow its privacy settings.
Can the reports include my marketplace orders?
If the marketplace lets us export or connect the data, yes. Tell us which channels you sell on, and we confirm what can be included before we begin.
Will you explain the numbers to me?
Yes. Each report has a short note in plain words about what the figures mean, and the Premium package adds a call to go through them with you.
